correctness.rationale: Chen–Hu–Ma span incidence resolution Y=P_Gr(k+1,N)(Sym² S^∨) has positive-dimensional fibers solely over doubled k-plane cycles Z=Gr(k,N), with fiber P^{n-k}. Dimensions dimY=(k+1)(n-k)+binom(k+2,2)-1, dimZ=k(n+1-k) give codimZ=n+binom(k,2). Semismall iff 2(n-k)≤codim, equality iff n=2k+binom(k,2). Small resolution theorem then identifies IH(Q)=H(Y); at equality semismall decomposition gives one constant rank-one local system on Z shifted 2r, requiring subtraction q^r P_Gr(k,N). Projective-bundle and Schubert formulas yield claimed Gaussian products and even pure Tate groups. Independent Gaussian q calculation at p=1,n=5 produced (1,2,4,6,9,11,13,13,13,11,9,6,4,2,1), sum105. The cited source fiber classification is a necessary substantive premise and is explicitly credited.
